prompt:
Instrumental, calm and curious history-of-science underscore for short discovery stories. Warm felt piano motif over soft plucked strings and a gentle music-box celesta, light airy pads, a quiet sense of wonder and a small lift of discovery in the middle, then settling. Steady, even, loopable: the ending flows back into the opening. Sits well under a spoken narrator, leaving the mid-range clear. No vocals.
Pace: 72-84 BPM
NOT: big drums, risers, booms, trailer hits, EDM, pop beat, vocals or choir, cartoon or comedy stings; not the HOS 001–006 film beds or the OWB standalone-Shorts bed (no space shimmer, no cosmic drone).
